record.one_liner: Developer API that connects apps to users' bank accounts and financial data.
record.auth_notes: Every request uses a client_id plus secret pair from the Dashboard. The OAuth endpoints are for Plaid's own token grants (client_credentials, refresh_token, token-exchange), not a third-party user-consent flow for developers.
record.access_notes: Sign up in the Dashboard to get Sandbox API keys for free. Production access and pricing were not verified in fetched pages; the pricing page lists a Pay as You Go tier with self-service support.
record.api_notes: Documented HTTP API with per-product endpoints; the pricing page lists core products plus all products including beta on custom plans.
record.blocker_notes: Sandbox credentials are self-serve. Production approval steps were not checked, so treat production readiness as unverified.
